blocks.en: We remark that since there is an extension operator from $H^k(\mathbb{R}_+^m)$ to $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$, we also have a trace operator which maps a function in $H^k(\mathbb{R}_+^m)$ to its boundary values in $H^{k-1/2}(\mathbb{R}^{m-1})$. By using a partition of unity argument, we can extend this result to domains with bounded boundary.
blocks.zh: 注意, 由于存在从 $H^k(\mathbb{R}_+^m)$ 到 $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 的延拓算子, 也有一个迹算子, 将 $H^k(\mathbb{R}_+^m)$ 中的函数映到它在 $H^{k-1/2}(\mathbb{R}^{m-1})$ 中的边界值. 利用单位分解论证, 可以将这一结果推广到具有有界边界的区域.

blocks.en: Let $k$ be a positive integer. Assume that $\Omega$ is of class $C^k$ and $\partial\Omega$ is bounded. Then there is a bounded trace operator $\Gamma:H^k(\Omega)\to H^{k-1/2}(\partial\Omega)$. Moreover, $\Gamma$ has a bounded right inverse.
blocks.zh: 设 $k$ 为正整数. 假设 $\Omega$ 为 $C^k$ 类, $\partial\Omega$ 有界. 那么存在有界迹算子 $\Gamma:H^k(\Omega)\to H^{k-1/2}(\partial\Omega)$. 此外, $\Gamma$ 具有有界右逆.
blocks.label: thm:smooth-domain-trace-and-right-inverse

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: If $l<k$, then the $l$th derivatives have traces in $H^{k-l-1/2}(\partial\Omega)$. It is customary to formulate trace theorems involving higher derivatives in terms of derivatives in the direction normal to $\partial\Omega$.
blocks.zh: 若 $l<k$, 则第 $l$ 阶导数在 $H^{k-l-1/2}(\partial\Omega)$ 中具有迹. 通常用沿 $\partial\Omega$ 法向方向的导数, 来表述涉及高阶导数的迹定理.
